teaching.title: Programming Teaching Assistance
bullets: Prepared worked examples on functions, lists, and arrays for review by the course instructor.
Helped organise assignment materials and submission records for the assigned programming topics.

projects.title: Graph Property Checker
bullets: Constructed examples and counterexamples for the represented rules in the team's C++ graph property checker.
Tested the implementation against hand-worked cases and explained the connection between formal definitions and implementation.

projects.title: Course Prerequisite Graph
bullets: Represented course prerequisite connections using adjacency lists in C++ as part of the team project.
Explained algorithm choices and computational complexity for the course prerequisite graph project, which used Git.

projects.title: Local Book Search Interface
bullets: Built a local browser interface with form inputs for the team's book search project using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Implemented event handling and input validation, and documented the interface and its local data flow.
